verdict.rationale: Egnyte documents sharing content with people outside the organization, restricting shares to specific email addresses with revocation, and rule-based watermarking on delivery under Enhanced Sharing Controls. These cover the core of controlled external sharing for diligence, but the other data-room elements the story names are not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit view-only links, download blocking or controls, access visibility or audit of who viewed what, data-room folder organization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a lightweight data room — organized shared folders with view-only links, download controls, and access visibility for diligence

citations.quote: Ability to share content with users who are not part of your organization.
Limit file sharing to specific email addresses and revoke permissions when necessary.
Set up rules to automatically watermark sensitive documents upon delivery. Part of Enhanced Sharing Controls.
